name: Akuochi Valkyria Teikoku ~Odin-sama, Penis Band no Ojikan Desu wa yo♪~
original_name: 悪堕ちヴァルキュリア帝国 ～オーディン様、ペニスバンドのお時間ですわよ♪～
source:
Asgard, realm of Gods, has been taken by the Orcish Insurgence, and protagonist Odin is their prisoner of war.
He commands his loyal goddesses to defend him, so why have they turned on him like this?
Darkness has corrupted the hearts of beautiful Valkyria, Freyja and Skuld. The Insurgence will use Odin's own women to break him down!

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE123662.html]DLSite. English[/url]]
translation:
诸神的国度阿斯加德已被兽人叛乱占领，主角奥丁是他们的战俘。
他命令忠诚的女神们来保护他，她们为什么要这样攻击他？
黑暗腐蚀了美丽的瓦尔基里亚、芙蕾雅和斯库尔德的心。叛乱者将利用奥丁自己的女人来击败他！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE123662.html]DLS站点。英语[/url]]
